summary: Completed the initial evidence-backed review of Samsung Electronics' Vienna-traded common GDR after its 2026-07-29 lower-Bollinger transition. SSU.VI fell 26.15% from July 1 to EUR 3,220 and finished 1.71% below the lower band, but RSI was not oversold, volume was not abnormal, and only seven units traded. Samsung's record first-quarter earnings and sharply stronger second-quarter preliminary guidance disclose no operating impairment explaining the decline. The GDR's negligible Vienna liquidity and the absence of a fresh KRW/EUR plus same-timestamp cross-venue valuation bridge prevent a supportable intrinsic EUR range. The current assessment is medium-confidence ineligible with explicit liquidity and valuation blockers. No strategy or idea refresh was created because the full strategy gate failed and neither the payload nor an accepted canonical relationship names an idea.

evidence.claim: SSU.VI closed at EUR 3,220 on 2026-07-29, down 4.45% for the session and 26.15% from 2026-07-01. The close was 1.71% below the EUR 3,276.03 lower Bollinger band; RSI was 33.66, volume anomaly was 0.84, only seven units traded, and bollinger_below_lower was the sole transition. The canonical source-price hash is 6eb025c45adfb61e4cb0d75f20bfdcf333ee0fbfc604998f4160f0fedb16fcdb.

Samsung reported first-quarter sales of KRW 133.9 trillion, operating profit of KRW 57.2 trillion, net profit of KRW 47.2 trillion, common-share EPS of KRW 7,123, cash of KRW 147.4 trillion, and debt of KRW 28.1 trillion. Device Solutions produced KRW 81.7 trillion of sales and KRW 53.7 trillion of operating profit, supporting the AI-server-memory thesis and balance-sheet strength.

Samsung's July 7 pre-earnings guidance called for approximately KRW 171 trillion of second-quarter sales and KRW 89.4 trillion of operating profit. The preliminary release supports, rather than invalidates, the operating thesis, but detailed results due July 30 remain necessary to assess normalization and cash conversion.

Issuer and exchange disclosures identify the common GDR as ISIN US7960508882, London symbol SMSN and Vienna symbol SSU; one GDR economically represents 25 Korean common shares. This confirms the immutable instrument identity and explains why fresh KRW/EUR and cross-venue evidence are necessary for a supportable EUR valuation.
